verses.1: And when Adonai-Tzaddik, the king of Jerusalem, heard that Joshua had destroyed Jericho, and that he had done the same with Ai and its king, then the people of Gibeah also obeyed and became part of Israel.
verses.2: They were terrified greatly, for it was a great city, greater in size than any of the cities of the kingdom. Its people were also very powerful.
verses.3: And Adonai-zedek, king of Jerusalem, sent messengers to Hoham, king of Hebron; to Piraim, king of Yarmut; to Yafiah, king of Lakish; and to Dibri, king of Eglon.
verses.4: Help me, O God! Help me to overcome my enemies, so that Jehoshua and the children of Israel may be saved.
verses.5: And they gathered together, and five kings of the Amorites came: King of Jerusalem, King of Hebron, King of Jarmuth, King of Laish, and King of Eglon. They and all their armies camped on Mount Hebron, and they fought against it.
verses.6: And the men of Gibeah sent messengers to Jehoshaphat, to the camp at Gilgal. They said, “Do not delay in coming to us. Come quickly and save us! We are under attack by all the kings of the Amorites who live on those hills.”
verses.7: And Joshua stood on the hill, along with all the people who fought with him, and all the leaders of the tribes.
verses.8: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them. For in your hands are all these people; no one of them will stand before you.”
verses.9: And suddenly, Joshua came to them. All night long, he rose from the underworld.
verses.10: And Jehovah made them flee before Israel. They fled in great numbers through the wilderness. They were chased along the way from Bethel to Hazor. They fled until they reached Azekah and Makkedah.
verses.11: And there was a great disaster among the Israelites. They were in Moab, near the city of Boorhan. God sent down huge stones from heaven upon them, causing many to die. Many of them died because of those rocks that were thrown down by the Israelites during the battle.
verses.12: Then Joshua will speak to Jehovah on that day, when Jehovah makes the words known before the children of Israel. He will say, “In front of the eyes of the Israelites, there will be blood and insects in the valley of Aijalon.”
verses.13: And the sun shone, but it remained stationary until its enemies were defeated. This is not written in the book of righteousness. The sun remained in the middle of the sky, and it did not move forward to shine on those days when it should have done so.
verses.14: And it was not like this in those days before and after. There was no one who could hear the voice of Jehovah. For Jehovah fought for Israel.
verses.15: And Joshua and all of Israel sat down with him in the camp at Gilgal.
verses.16: And these five kings fled, and they hid in the cave in Makkedah.
verses.17: And Joshua said, “The five kings were found buried in the cave at Makkedah.”
verses.18: And Joshua said, “Cast huge stones into the mouth of the pit. Then put men there to guard them.”
verses.19: And you shall not stand against your enemies, pursuing them. Do not let them enter your cities, for Jehovah your God has given them into your hands.
verses.20: And it happened that Joshua and the sons of Israel went out to attack them with a great slaughter, until they were completely destroyed. The survivors who managed to escape from them came to the cities of Midian.
verses.21: And all the people returned to the camp at Gibeah, near Yehoshua Makdah. They did not dare to take any of Israel’s women as wives for their sons.
verses.22: And Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave, and let these five kings come out of it.”
verses.23: And they did so. They brought forth these five kings from the cave: King Jerusalem, King Hebron, King Yarmut, King Lakish, and King Eglon.
verses.24: And when these kings were brought before Joshua, Joshua called out to all the people of Israel. He said, “Go forward, and lay your feet on the necks of these kings.” So they did as he said; they laid their feet on the necks of those kings.
verses.25: And Joshua said to them, “Do not be afraid. Have courage and stand firm. For this is what Jehovah will do to all those who fight against you.”
verses.26: And Joshua killed them after that. He put them up on five trees, and they remained hanging there until dawn.
verses.27: And it happened that, when the sun rose, Joshua ordered them to be taken down from the trees. They were then thrown into the pit where they were buried. Big stones were placed over the pit until today.
verses.28: And on that day, Jehosiah destroyed Makkedah. He slaughtered its king and all those who were inside it. He didn’t leave any survivors. He treated Makkedah’s king just as Jehoiachin was treated by him.
verses.29: And Joshua and all of Israel passed through Gibeah and Libnah, and they fought against Libnah.
verses.30: And Jehovah also gave her to Israel. He took her kingdom away from her, and he killed all the people who lived there. He didn’t leave any survivors. He treated her like how he treated King Jericho.
verses.31: And Joshua and all of Israel passed through Libnah to Keshonah. They camped there and fought against them.
verses.32: And Jehovah gave Labash into the hands of Israel. On the second day, they captured him and killed him with an axe. All the people who were in him were also killed, just as Hebrom had done to Labash.
verses.33: Then King Gezer went up to help Lachish. Jehosiah defeated him and his people, until no survivors were left of them.
verses.34: And Joshua and all of Israel passed through the land of Canaan, along with them. They camped there, and then fought against the people of Canaan.
verses.35: And she was captured that day. They slaughtered her along with all the people who were inside her. All those who were in her body were killed, just as Lot was killed.
verses.36: And Joshua and all of Israel went up against Gibeon together. They fought against it.
verses.37: And they captured her and destroyed her along with her king and all her cities. They didn’t leave behind any survivors. They destroyed everything that belonged to her, just as they did to Jezabel.
verses.38: And Joshua and all of Israel sat with him, and they fought against them.
verses.39: And they captured her, along with her queen and all her cities. They destroyed everything in those cities; they killed every living being there. They didn’t leave any survivors, just as they had done to Haboran, to Dibra, and to Labana and their queens.
verses.40: And Joshua destroyed all the land, including the mountains, hills, valleys, and all its kings. He left no survivors, and all the living people were killed, just as Jehovah, the God of Israel, commanded.
verses.41: And Joshua took control of the sacred land from Bethel to Azah, and all the land between there and Gibeon.
verses.42: And all these kings, and their lands, will be conquered by Joshua once and for all. For Jehovah is the God of Israel, and He will fight for Israel.
verses.43: And Joshua and all of Israel sat down with him in the camp at Gilgal.
